mapper.select: select plan_id, plan_no, plant_cd, status, time_zone, purged_at is not null as purged from aps_plan where plan_id = #{id}
select status from aps_plan where plan_id = #{id} for update

select m.plan_mat_id, m.wo_id, x.wo_no, m.op_seq, m.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.proc_type, i.use_yn as item_use_yn, m.unit_cd, m.short_qty, m.need_at, exists (select 1 from aps_plan_pr k join srm_pr r on r.pr_id = k.pr_id where k.plan_mat_id = m.plan_mat_id and r.status not in ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') and exists (select 1 from srm_pr_line l where l.pr_line_id = k.pr_line_id)) as linked from aps_plan_mat m join aps_plan_wo x on x.plan_wo_id = m.plan_wo_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id where m.plan_id = #{planId} and m.plan_mat_id in #{id} order by i.item_cd, m.need_at nulls last, m.plan_mat_id

select distinct on (s.item_id) s.item_id, s.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.lead_days, s.moq, s.order_mult from srm_source s join srm_supplier p on p.cust_id = s.cust_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = s.cust_id where s.use_yn = 'Y' and p.trade_status <> 'BLOCKED' and s.item_id in #{id} order by s.item_id, s.priority, c.cust_cd
select pr_line_id, item_id, line_no from srm_pr_line where pr_id = #{prId} order by line_no
select pr_no from srm_pr where pr_id = #{prId}

insert into aps_plan_pr (comp_cd, plan_id, plan_mat_id, wo_id, op_seq, item_id, short_qty, pr_id, pr_line_id, created_by) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{planId}, #{r.planMatId}, #{r.woId}, #{r.opSeq}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.shortQty}, #{prId}, #{r.prLineId}, #{by})
